title: Introducing The New Clo Zfab Kit
description: A groundbreaking fabric digitization solution, transforming the garment and textile industries. Powered by CLO AI, the CLO zFab Kit enables brands, vendors and suppliers to create accurate, high-quality digital representations of fabrics with unprecedented ease and precision. Learn more at zfabkit.clo3d.com.
transcript: . Hey, I'm Kaye, Head of Research at CloseSoul. I'm Mason, a 3D Design and Implementation Specialist. Hi, I'm Justin, 3D Design and Implementation Lead at CloseSoul. . So it's finally happening, the moment you've all been waiting for. We are excited to introduce our new CloseZ Fab Kit. For many of us at Close, it's been quite the journey getting here, and we can't wait to share it with you. Since our last Fabric launch, we've gotten tons of feedback from you. You made it clear that while the hardware is useful and important, what really matters is the quality of our service, especially the training and support. With this new release, we're committed to maintain the highest standard of user support. We also heard you loud and clear on what needed improvement. The devices were tricky to use, manual measurements took forever, and user error was affecting the quality. You also wanted a texture scanning solution that fits smoothly into the Close ecosystem, and existing options out there were pricey. We want to reflect all of your feedback, so we've created a new CloseZ Fab Kit, reduced the human error that occurs in manual measurements, and introduced innovative features that improve the process. CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit Presenting the CloseZ Fab Cutter, which lets you cut fabric samples uniformly every single time. CloseZ Fab Kit No more struggling with small scissors. CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit Then, CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit CloseZ Fab Kit learning AI to automate and simplify the measurement process. That means quicker and more accurate analysis of fabric properties. And lastly, the Z-Fast scanner is close very own, affordable fabric texture scanner that is perfectly integrated with our software. Texture scanning is now easier, faster, and more seamless for CLO users. The new CLO Z-Fab Kit will be rolling out in Q4 this year for our enterprise and educational institution clients. If you're interested in getting your hands on it, reach out to your regional CLO reps. With enhanced automation, accuracy, and speed, we are confident that the new CLO Z-Fab Kit will make your workflow even faster and easier. We can't wait to hear how the new kit works for you, so we can keep making it even better. Let us know what you think!
markdown_content: ## Introduction to the CloseZ Fab Kit This section introduces the CloseZ Fab Kit, highlighting the product's purpose, development background, and primary improvements based on user feedback. It focuses on user support, automation, and integration within the Close ecosystem. The CloseZ Fab Kit is a new product from CloseSoul designed to enhance fabric sample cutting, measurement, and texture scanning. The development was driven by extensive user feedback emphasizing the need for improved usability, reduced manual errors, and better integration with existing workflows. The company prioritized maintaining high standards of training and support alongside hardware improvements. ## Key Features and Improvements This section details the main components of the CloseZ Fab Kit, including the CloseZ Fab Cutter, AI-powered measurement automation, and the Z-Fast fabric texture scanner. It explains their functions and benefits. - **CloseZ Fab Cutter**: A precision tool for uniformly cutting fabric samples. It replaces small scissors, simplifying the process and ensuring consistent sample sizes. - **AI Measurement Automation**: Incorporates learning AI technology to automate and simplify fabric property measurements. This reduces human error and accelerates analysis, providing quicker and more accurate results. - **Z-Fast Scanner**: An affordable, proprietary fabric texture scanner fully integrated with CloseSoul’s software ecosystem. It streamlines texture scanning, making it faster and easier compared to existing, more expensive solutions. ## Availability and Client Information This section provides rollout timing and target users for the CloseZ Fab Kit. The CloseZ Fab Kit will be available in Q4 of this year, initially targeting enterprise customers and educational institutions. Interested parties are encouraged to contact their regional CloseSoul representatives for acquisition details. ## Summary The CloseZ Fab Kit offers enhanced automation, accuracy, and speed in fabric sample preparation and analysis. With its integrated hardware and software solutions, it aims to improve workflow efficiency and reduce manual errors, backed by CloseSoul’s commitment to user training and support.
